# 思绪垃圾桶 · Thought Trash Bin

> Free, open-source (MIT), offline-first brain dump web app. Write rants, ideas or private thoughts, drag the note into a trash bin to save it. Notes stay in the user's browser; no account, no server. Chinese and English.
> 免费开源（MIT）、离线优先的想法垃圾桶网页：写下烦心事、灵感、心里话，拖进垃圾桶保存。数据只存在浏览器，无需注册，中英双语。

Key facts:
- Storage: browser IndexedDB; optionally each note as a .md file in a user-chosen folder (File System Access API, Edge/Chrome).
- Works offline except AI sort-out.
- AI sort-out: user's own DeepSeek API key, kept only in the browser and sent only to DeepSeek on request; or copy a ready-made prompt into any AI.
- Mood tags (Rant / Idea / Deep thoughts), list search and filter, weekly recap card (PNG), Markdown backup export.
- Not encrypted, no cloud sync, not a medical/therapy tool.
- Anonymous visit counts via Cloudflare Web Analytics; note content is never collected.
